description: Read native controls on the screen. Pass pointX and pointY for points on iOS Sims, pixels elsewhere. Use x and y for screen fractions (0 to 1). Leave all points out to list controls, with types, labels, IDs, and frames. This includes tabs, alerts, and sheets. A point read also checks the app view and Buoy's cover. iOS Sims use idb; Android uses uiautomator. Real iPhones show just the app view.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

pointX.description: From the left. iOS Sims use points. Other hosts use pixels.

pointY.description: From the top. iOS Sims use points. Other hosts use pixels.

serial.description: Android: the adb serial, when several devices are connected.

name: native_inspect
